# analyze

Analyze schema and display dependency graph

## Usage

```
ppds data analyze [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--schema` | `-s` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to schema.xml file |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
